goal: Prevent database read corruption from masquerading as missing keys or failing silently in RPC queries
Centralize fatal error handling on LevelDB read failures and simplify the coins view stack
agreement: Open objection: aborting the entire node on optional index corruption is unnecessary harm (ajtowns)
Resolved objection: continuing execution on deserialization failure risks bad state (maflcko)
Support for removing the coins view wrapper indirection layer (andrewtoth)

categories.name: indexes
why: P3 because corrupted reads in secondary indexes trigger fatal errors instead of partial query failures
Affects only nodes running optional indexes with corrupted data on disk

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it ensures database corruption during coin lookups halts the node instead of masquerading as missing keys
Simplifies the coin view architecture across chainstate validation and storage
